names: Ammonium phosphates: (i) monoammonium phosphate (ii) diammonium phosphate

more_info.overview: E342 covers monoammonium and diammonium orthophosphate, which are distinct ammonium salts of phosphoric acid. Its acidity-control function is to adjust or maintain food pH. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
